format.note: Repository-defined open files, not a claim of an external knowledge-format standard. Paths are relative to this file.

stable_constraints: Local analysis with no hidden data uploads
Native Windows desktop entry point with no required browser, Docker or WSL
Real pinned upstream tools with documented portability patches
Independent app and pack versions; small starter
Declarative scientifically typed pack inputs, parameters and outputs
Individual operations and branching pipelines with explicit input provenance
Reviewable methods, DAG and execution provenance retained with results
Immutable published packs and explicit saved-pipeline version pins
Scientific known-answer checks separate from process exit status
Catalogue signatures, source provenance and third-party licensing preserved
Large scientific databases remain separate local inputs; hashes and explicit external-model declarations preserve their distinct evidence scopes
Explicit reference retrieval remains separate from local analysis; release, assembly and byte identities are frozen with run provenance

maintenance.source_of_behavior: Current checked-out source and reproducible observations
maintenance.source_of_requirements: Project owner decisions recorded in purpose-and-decisions.md
maintenance.update_rule: Update affected topic and evidence after a change; refresh the dated release snapshot after publication.
